race.comment: Good race. LOFTY THOUGHTS (2) has placed in all three runs this time in, well backed last time but just finding one better over this route. Takes on a couple of nice types here but is rock hard fit and should get a nice run. EARTHING (4) was a dominant maiden winner at Pakenham Synthetic last time out when rising to this trip. Up in grade now but should measure right up. ANGLAND LASS (11) looked good coming from off the pace on her debut at Bendigo over 1300m. She draws well and the extra 100m will only suit better. BELCONY (7) resumes with some consistently good form around this level last time in, respecting.
